third-party-scripts.note: 1st-party claim rests on @nuxt/scripts useScript (official module, verified: deferred onNuxtReady load). Worker offload is NOT self-contained: useScript partytown:true only renders <script type="text/partytown">; in a one-off build without @nuxtjs/partytown the tag was emitted, /~partytown/partytown.js returned 404 and the script was never fetched or run. With @nuxtjs/partytown installed it runs via the worker (this spec).

reactivity.note: Passes at Vue's granularity: setup never re-runs and the state-owning component never re-renders, but the component that reads the ref re-runs its render effect (VDOM, no Vapor mode in Vue 3.5).

css-inlining.note: Nuxt's default (features.inlineStyles = id => id.includes('.vue')) already inlines SFC CSS; `true` additionally inlines global CSS (0 stylesheet links remain).
